snippet.title: Mancave - Wife Free Zone Longplay (C64) [QHD]
snippet.description:
Follow me on Twitter @ https://twitter.com/Al82_Retro
Get Great Retro Scene News @ http://www.vintageisthenewold.com
Developed by Megastyle and published by Psytronik in 2019

A brand new 2019 release from Chris Stanley, Roy Widding and the rest of the Megastyle crew!

The objective is simple - help Richard secure his stash of porn mags before his wife finds out, but stay out of the way of family members, especially Richard's mother-in-law!

Purchase the game online from https://megastyle.itch.io/mancave
